text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B in stages banked gains while preserving some upside; I should keep position sizing and my plan—not the satisfaction of a realized gain—guiding future sales.","A profitable sale in Stock C did not prevent my account from falling overall. I should evaluate portfolio-level risk and results, not treat one winning trade as proof of a good decision.","After buying Stocks A, C and D, I should review concentration and cash carefully, and avoid letting loss aversion or short-term price moves keep me from making disciplined decisions."]}
